notes.title: Patch Notes For v1.0.3.9
notes.content:
This small patch includes fixes for several small bugs and one enhancement.

Fixes include:

 Fixed intro/tutorial video stuttering issue on certain platforms.
 Fixed spelling error in intro/tutorial video.
 Fixed bug that would result in arena tiles not properly showing damage after an explosion, even though they took damage.

Enhancements include:

 Explosions do twice (2x) their previous damage; explosions include uranium reactor overloads and the explosion resulting from players being shot with lasers.  Explosions have always been proportional to the amount of uranium that a player is holding, but now the damage is twice (2x) as large.
 Round-robin tournaments improved to prevent endless tie-breaker matches; new tournament and player stats added to match completion screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes For v1.0.2.0
notes.content:
This small patch includes fixes for several achievements which were not working properly.

Fixes for achievements include:

 AI opponents no longer able to satisfy achievements.
 Laser & Stun achievements correctly given to player who scores the Laser Kill or Stun on their opponent.
 All Clear achievement correctly accounts for destroyed base tiles which could result in achievement being given too soon.


If you would like to reset all of your Square Saga: The Trials achievements so that you can earn any that may have been bugged,  you can do so using the Steam Console.  WARNING - this will reset all achievements for Square Saga: The Trials, so make sure you want to do this before following these steps.

[olist]
 Open the Steam Console by pressing the WIN + R button to open the Run dialog
 Enter steam://open/console and select OK
 There should now be a new CONSOLE menu option in your primary Steam window following the STORE, LIBRARY, COMMUNITY, "YOURNAME" options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892844/9b2922fafe539a9dd684f45e03aa61f123e7268f.png
 Select the CONSOLE menu option
 Enter reset_all_stats 2770270
 2770270 is the App ID for Square Saga: The Trials
 It may take several minutes for the achievements to show as cleared; sometimes navigating away from the game in your library and then back again is all it takes.
[/olist]

Hope you are enjoying the game!
